intro: Designed for doing more, our Jaxon table brings expandable utility and stylish storage to modern homes. From coffee catchups to creative bursts—it’s all here.

features.title: Modern suede style
features.text: Its soft suede finish in Rimini Walnut brings a warm, stylish look that fits effortlessly into any living space.

features.title: Lift, extend, enjoy
features.text: The lift-up mechanism with extendable panels transforms this table into a shared workspace or snack zone.

features.title: Everything in reach
features.text: With storage under the lift-top and a central open shelf, your essentials stay neat and close at hand.

features.title: Extra storage below
features.text: An excellent space-saving solution, its bottom-level shelf adds room for magazines, boxes, or décor—smart, spacious, and sleek.

features.title: Tidy wires, tidy mind
features.text: A built-in grommet makes cable management simple—no more cluttered cords or messy setups.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Jaxon Large Convertible Coffee Table
